title: Cosmic Nursery Gathering
description: A woman in a blue headscarf and robe sits in a wooden rocking chair breastfeeding two infants with glowing blue bottles while two more babies rest on her lap. In a surreal cosmic wooden room with a starry ceiling, an older man in a plaid shirt and cap stands near floating orbs and lotus flowers as children and another seated elder interact with magical elements, surrounded by birds, cherry blossoms, and zodiac symbols.
prompt: A serene woman in a deep blue headscarf and robe sits in an ornate wooden rocking chair breastfeeding two babies with glowing blue bottles, two more infants on her lap covered by a patterned blanket. In a rustic wooden room with a starry celestial ceiling and zodiac symbols on the walls, an elderly man in a plaid shirt and cap stands holding a glowing orb while a seated elder and several small children reach for floating lights and lotus flowers. Blue birds fly nearby, cherry blossoms drift through the air, and a large bowl of glowing orbs and lotuses sits in the foreground, ethereal cosmic atmosphere with soft magical lighting.
